mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year CPI increase above 3.0% signals rising inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and INDPRO both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS and INDPRO both decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), positive payroll employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.1% MoM) signals strengthening labor conditions that boost corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production above 100.0 (the 2017 base) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts decline below 1400.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, reducing construction sector activity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals an overheating economy that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5% and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5% and RSAFS declines from prior month.
